name: EV drivetrain
description: A battery electric vehicle in three levels: vehicle control and powertrain at the top; battery pack and motor drive inside the powertrain; an averaged DC-DC converter inside the motor drive. Two variant subsystems switch battery chemistry (LFP, NMC) and motor type (PM DC machine, simple DC motor); two configurations pick them together.
